checklist.why: Purpose stated but names no sibling to use instead (TaskWarning, a field status line)
Don'ts say when not (a warning that still records goes to the field status line)
Box, headline, consequence, summary and Clear named and shown
Neither tone is used by any atlas screen; farrowing and piglet-processing use TaskWarning or their own CSS
The Cleared + Undo state is not rendered in the preview
One banner at a time stated
Tones differ by headline words and weight, not colour alone
No headline length cap or long/zh example
One live region; focus return via handFocus specified
Raw px (1px border, 4px gaps); no CSS-variable list
Does not link TaskWarning or state the relation (variant or duplicate)
Danger and correction render cleanly at 375px, but the Cleared/Undo state has no proof

variants.name: danger
findings: Same job and nearly the same face as TaskWarning red (farrowing's danger band); no screen uses Banner for it

variants.name: correction
findings: farrowing.edit shows no banner in its captured state; the archived edit.html slice is the only user
Clear is 44px tall; Cleared/Undo not rendered

findings.text: Banner and TaskWarning do the same job (a consequence above a commit, on a wash, with optional text actions) with two implementations: Banner danger is red-wash/red border with a 14/700 headline; TaskWarning red is red-wash/danger-border with a 12/700 title. Only TaskWarning is used (piglet-processing.phone-clash, farrowing.blocked).
findings.fix: Merge them: one Banner with tones danger / correction / notice, built once; TaskWarning becomes Banner at the skeleton's 12px size (a size property), not a second component.

findings.text: The Home offline banner ("3 records saved on this device · No connection · waiting to upload", workbench.today) is a third look-alike: amber wash, a leading icon, the whole box a door with ›. Banner forbids icons; TaskWarning's amber door banner matches it.
findings.fix: Make it the merged Banner's notice tone with the door property (icon optional, the whole box one button at least 48px), and render Home with it.

findings.text: Clear (46x44) is under the 48px glove floor.
findings.fix: Give banner text actions min-height: var(--control-height) and make the summary row 48px.

findings.text: Cleared + Undo (5s) is specified but not rendered in the preview.
findings.fix: Add a Cleared/Undo example to preview.html.

findings.text: Raw px, no CSS-variable list, no headline length cap.
findings.fix: Tokenise the 1px/4px values, list the variables, cap the headline at one line with a zh example.

proposals.name: Banner + TaskWarning
proposals.why: Same job (a consequence before a commit, or a pending notice), two implementations; only TaskWarning ships in screens

proposals.name: Banner · notice (door)
proposals.why: The Home offline/upload banner and farrowing's "Save your correction first · Review ›" are an amber notice that opens something
